curatedLayouts.reason: The colossal pouch is made by stitching the small, medium, large and giant pouches together, which consumes them, so a player cannot carry both. It holds 40 essence in one inventory slot against 30 across four. The Abyss strategy page predates it and never mentions it; Guardians of the Rift lists both tiers.
